judge: judge_p4env (P4 round 1, lane env, lab :5174 vs MAIN lab :5197)
why_not_pass: No regression found and every shipped fix verified, but the lane's own G3 items (a, b, c-top-edge) and the G4 pale box remain open (minor each), plus one pre-existing minor glitch newly observed (summit zig-zag at late idle).

verified.ident_p4env0: re-run (tools/ident.mjs, 20 moving frames): ?p4env=0 on :5174 == :5197 at T1 6/6 targets 16/16 programs, T2 6/6 16/16, T0 mobile 2/2 12/12, ?envlake=plate 2/2 12/12 (id/m_*.json vs id/l_*.json). Lane ON differs (final, mirror, walk; rx-cloud, rx-plate-baked, rx-plate-baked-mirror), so the test is live (id/on_T1.json). ?p4crest=0&p4tex=0&p4card=0 == :5197 at T1 6/6 16/16 (id/l_subs_T1.json). T0 lane ON: final bit-identical to MAIN still and moving at t~6 (t0/).
verified.perf: perf/perf_ab.json: 6 interleaved pairs, T1, SLOT_BG=0, load 3.9-7.8: MAIN median 21.9 ms vs lane 21.6 ms (ratio 0.986); first 4 pairs at load < 5: MAIN 21.4/21.3/21.7/21.9, lane 21.3/21.5/21.6/21.5. No measurable cost (builder: +1.3 %, inside noise).
verified.typecheck: npx tsc -p tsconfig.hero.json --noEmit --incremental false && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false: clean, no files written.
verified.patch: p4env_vs_aa7.patch applied to aa7 copies reproduces the lane's 4 files byte for byte; it also dry-runs cleanly onto MAIN's current working tree (which carries AA8 edits in PlateEnvironment.ts). Lane vs aa7: only those 4 files + public/hero/baked/Object_2_010_p4.webp (sha256 3ce65b26... as stated).
verified.texture: Object_2_010_p4.webp vs MAIN's Object_2_010_f1.webp: exactly 5,729 texels differ and every one equals step 2 (Object_2_010.webp); all others identical.
verified.rest_frame: Deterministic still (builder's id/main_still2 vs final_still, re-measured): 276 px > 2 levels; 202 ridge px (lane-MAIN +4.6 R; mean |x-F000| 38.9 -> 37.3, closer to the reference), 73 px on the iceberg's right flank x1203-1222 y337-377 (+4.5 R, invisible at 1x), 1 other px. q00 region stats MAIN vs lane qc within 2 levels (capture-time noise); still-frame region stats identical.

ab_method: tools/abshots.mjs: engine RAF disabled, frame stepping, identical sequence on both labs -> same sim time per shot (ab/m vs ab/l, 38 shots: 10 ptr spots, 6x hold/pop/release, rest + 4 orbit spots at t~90 and t~150). tools/abana.py lists every |d|>2 cluster (ab/diff/diff_*.png).
fixed_confirmed: G1 ghost iceberg + far-peak sliver gone in ptr_right/top_right/bottom_right (ev/g1_right_pct.png, ev/g1_right_x1.png) and the left band in ptr_left/top_left/bottom_left (ev/g1_left_pct.png); far range stays unveiled; no new ghost at t~90/150 (ev/ab_late90_skyline.png).

G1 side effect, improvement: the bright veil band along the far white peak's right flank in the dolly poses (hold, pop, release, orb) is gone (ev/ab_rim4x.png, ev/ab_holdBL.png, ev/ab_orb_rel.png; hold_L max 87, mean -23 luma in the band).
G4 hairlines gone in ptr_left/top_left/bottom_left (ev/g4_hair_left.png, g4_hair_tl.png, g4_hair_bl.png) and also in hold_L / pop_TR where MAIN shows them (ev/ab_hold_right.png).

G4 black slits gone in the right orbits (ridge box x0-330 y200-470 n<50: 531 -> 16, 779 -> 16, 794 -> 16; min 19-21 -> 42; ev/g4_slit_right.png, ev/ab_ridge.png) and the rest-frame black specks at t~90/150 (n<50 94 -> 0, 54 -> 0); crushed blue reflection specks in the lake too (ev/ab_water_bottom.png, MAIN 18,66,122 -> lane 89,106,131).
